usedFor: TagMango holds creator orders and courses, and Asana gets work through “Create Task or Subtask” after “Incomplete Order Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Incomplete Order Created” in TagMango, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A stalled order becomes a task with assignee, tags and dates, so someone chases it.

watchOut: “Course Progress Event” fires as progress starts, so it can create tasks often.
